props.text: Home / Service
Commercial truck service & repair in Florida & South Carolina
Factory-trained technicians, all makes and models, and service bays across our Carolina International Trucks and Rechtien International Trucks locations — built to get you back on the road.

Uptime is everything. Maintenance is a necessity when you own and operate a truck fleet — the constant rigors of travel make every rig susceptible to damage and wear, so regular upkeep and care are vital to the longevity and integrity of your fleet. Whether your truck is fresh out of the showroom or has already logged serious miles, our technicians do it right, from routine inspections to full system overhauls.

With every visit we provide transparent reporting, so you understand what was done, what is recommended and how to plan for future service. From light bulbs to complete engine replacements, if your vehicle has a diesel engine in it, we have the expertise to restore it and get it back to business.

props.text: When the truck can’t come to us.

Breakdowns can happen at the most inconvenient time, and that is where International mobile service comes in. Whether you are on the highway or at a job site, our mobile technicians can come to you to perform diagnostic work, roadside repairs or scheduled maintenance.

With this level of flexibility you minimise downtime and keep your operation moving. Our Accelerated Service lanes in South Carolina also give you a diagnostic advisory within two hours of your vehicle arriving — ask any of our service representatives for details.

props.text: Common questions.

items.q: What types of vehicles do you service?
items.a: We service all makes and models of commercial trucks and buses — from preventive maintenance and diagnostics to complete engine replacements.

items.q: Do you offer preventive fleet maintenance?
items.a: Yes. We offer preventive maintenance and fluid-analysis checks, while-you-wait PM service and proactive maintenance plans for fleets of any size.
Yes. We are authorized to perform warranty work for International, Cummins, CAT, Mitsubishi Fuso, IC Bus, Eaton, Arvin Meritor, Horton, Delco Remy and Leece Neville, among others.
Yes. Our mobile technicians can come to you on the highway or at a job site for diagnostics, roadside repairs or scheduled maintenance. Call your nearest location to arrange a visit.
Accelerated Service lanes at our South Carolina locations give you a diagnostic advisory within two hours of your vehicle arriving, so you get a rapid response and back on the road sooner.
